body.objective: Add exact Clifford, spinor and finite Lie-superalgebra machinery needed to extend the programme from scalar/Maxwell matter to fermions, chiral anomalies and supersymmetric or conformal matter candidates. The first consumers are sf:program/work/quantum-matter-gauge-representation-anomaly-selection and sf:program/work/quantum-first-new-conformal-gauge-field-carrier. The existing tensor and Lie-representation layers do not encode gamma-matrix relations, chirality, charge conjugation, Grassmann parity or Fierz completeness, so Conflux cannot safely compare fermionic BV carriers or propose matter-content cancellations.
body.stop_condition: Represent Clifford algebras Cl(p,q) over exact real/complex/algebraic coefficient domains, graded tensor products, spin and pin modules, chirality, charge conjugation and declared reality conditions; provide canonical gamma-word reduction, traces, antisymmetrized bases, spinor bilinears, Grassmann signs and dimension/signature-specific Fierz rearrangements with completeness witnesses. Add bounded finite Lie-superalgebra modules and supertrace/superdeterminant identities sufficient for BV field/ghost multiplets. Reproduce standard four-dimensional Dirac/Weyl trace and Fierz controls, construct one conformal fermion kinetic/BV carrier, and independently recover its local anomaly representation factors. Export typed spinor tensors, parities, reality structures and identities to Conflux while keeping dimension/signature/convention dependencies explicit.
body.forbid: no dimension-independent Fierz rule; no Euclidean/Lorentzian reality structures conflated; no commuting spinor substituted for a Grassmann field; no hard-coded Standard Model multiplet in lib/math; no gamma-matrix numerical representation used as the sole general proof; no anomaly coefficient inferred from representation data without the separate quantum analytic calculation
